title: Growth Marketing Manager Americas
description:
Who We Are
Amazfit is a global performance and wellness brand within Zepp Health, built for people who want more from the way they train, move, and live. Our smartwatches and connected ecosystem bring together thoughtful design, advanced health and fitness technology, and actionable intelligence to help people train with greater structure and understand their progress with greater clarity.

Our portfolio spans all-around training, running, outdoor endurance, everyday fitness, and recovery, from Balance, Cheetah, T-Rex, and Active watches to the growing Helio ecosystem. We pair that innovation with authentic credibility in sport through athletes including Olympic champion Gabby Thomas, All-Pro running back Derrick Henry, and HYROX world champion Hunter McIntyre, plus a landmark global partnership with HYROX. Together, these strengths give Amazfit global reach, technical credibility, and a growing place in sport and culture

The Role
Reporting to the Head of Americas Marketing, the Manager of Growth Marketing will lead full-funnel commercial growth across Amazfit's priority Americas markets, with North America as the immediate focus. Your mandate is to turn demand into predictable, profitable, and repeatable growth across DTC e-commerce, Amazon, paid acquisition, and customer retention.This is a senior player-coach role with executive visibility and meaningful accountability for revenue, margin, and investment. You will set the growth agenda, manage agency and specialist partners, and remain close enough to the platforms, creative, customer journey, and data to identify opportunities and move quickly. You will be supported by regional commercial and marketing partners and connected to global product, brand, creative, and technology teams.

Drive DTC and e-commerce growth
Own growth across the DTC funnel, including qualified traffic, lead capture, product discovery, landing pages, product detail pages, cart and checkout, conversion, average order value, and profitable revenue.
Build and execute a conversion-rate optimization roadmap across merchandising, bundles, offers, content, navigation, accessory attach, checkout, and post-purchase journeys.
Partner with e-commerce, product marketing, creative, and operations to ensure launches and promotions are compelling, easy to shop, and supported by the right inventory and demand plan.

Lead paid media and acquisition
Own paid acquisition strategy, execution, testing, optimization, budget allocation, and reporting across Google, Meta, YouTube, programmatic, retargeting, and emerging channels.
Stay close to the platforms and data, reviewing bidding, audiences, campaign architecture, creative performance, tracking, and spend, and stepping directly into optimization when speed or performance requires it.
Build a testing roadmap across audiences, messages, formats, offers, landing pages, and creative, then turn learnings into clear briefs for integrated marketing and creative partners.
Build productive agency partnerships grounded in clear objectives, commercial accountability, transparent reporting, and proactive recommendations.

Accelerate Amazon performance
Own Amazon marketing and demand-generation strategy in close partnership with sales and channel leaders, connecting retail media, product content, promotions, and brand investment to commercialgoals.
Improve paid efficiency and organic performance through disciplined management of Amazon Ads, search visibility, Storefront and product-detail content, promotional moments, ratings and reviews, and new-to-brand acquisition.
Use ROAS, ACoS, TACoS, conversion, share of voice, organic-to-paid mix, profitability, and incrementality to evaluate both channel growth and the quality of that growth.

Benefits of Working at Zepp Health
Competitive salary and annual bonus opportunity; paid vacation and sick time; a remote-friendly culture; medical, dental, vision, and life insurance; and a 401(k) with company matching. Team members also have access to innovative Amazfit products and opportunities to train, race, and experience the category firsthand.

Equal Opportunity
Zepp Health is an Equal Opportunity employer and welcomes everyone to our team. We are committed to an inclusive recruiting process that is free from bias, prejudice, and stereotypes. If you need a reasonable accommodation at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.

title: Industrial Designer
description:
At Amazfit, design and technology move together.

We create smart wearables that blend elegant form, human-centered function, and cutting-edge innovation — from performance-driven sports watches to lifestyle products that express personal style.

Our mission is simple: help people live healthier, more connected lives through design that feels natural, looks beautiful, and works effortlessly.

Join our passionate design team, where creativity, craftsmanship, and technology come together to shape the future of wearables.

What You’ll Do:
As an Industrial Designer, you’ll take ideas from concept to production — shaping next-generation wearables that define Amazfit’s design identity. You’ll collaborate across disciplines including product management, UX, engineering, and marketing to bring bold, refined ideas to life.
Create inspiring design concepts through sketching, 3D modeling, and visual storytelling
Develop details across CMF, ergonomics, and manufacturability with precision and creativity
Collaborate with mechanical and manufacturing partners to ensure design intent through production
Explore new materials, finishes, and trends to keep Amazfit products ahead of the curve
Present ideas clearly through visuals, mockups, and prototypes
Contribute to the evolution of Amazfit’s design DNA and product strategy

What We’re Looking For:
5+ years of experience in industrial/product design (wearables, lifestyle, or consumer electronics preferred)
A portfolio showcasing creative process, aesthetic sensitivity, and production-ready design
Proficiency in SolidWorks, Creo or Rhino, KeyShot, and Adobe CC
Strong understanding of CMF, DFM, and real-world manufacturing constraints
Deep sense of aesthetics and style, able to contribute to female-oriented design such as rings or jewelry-related projects
Experience or background in jewelry design is highly preferred
Proactive, open-minded, and passionate about design and innovation
Comfortable working in a collaborative, cross-functional environment
Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Design or equivalent

Bonus Points:
Experience designing wearable or sports-related products
Skills in graphic, motion, or interaction design
Understanding of UI/UX principles

Benefits of Working At Zepp Health:
Competitive salary, Vacation day, sick day
Health insurance, Vision insurance, Dental insurance, life insurance
401K & Matching
Year-end Bonus pay
Other Benefits

Zepp Health is an Equal Opportunity employer and welcomes everyone to our team. If you need reasonable accommodation at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know. In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (for example: she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

title: Senior Product Manager - Outdoor Navigation & Wearables
description:
Full-Time | Reports to Head of Product, Sports and Outdoor Business Unit

The Opportunity
We are hiring a Senior Product Manager for a new role on our rapidly growing North American product team. This new role offers high visibility, deep user proximity, and total ownership of the outdoor feature set focused on outdoor navigation, mapping, and telemetry for Amazfit, our category-defining brand. We make smart wearables for people who push their limits. If you live and breathe endurance sports, understand the nuances of GPS mapping and navigation, and want to shape hardware and software used by serious athletes worldwide then this is your entry ticket to the race.

What You Own
Product Vision & Roadmap
You will define key product features for outdoor navigation, mapping, and associated wearable features.
You will identify the moments that matter most to outdoor athletes and translate user behavior, training habits, and edge-case field needs into crisp, buildable product requirements.
You will partner closely with our development and engineering teams based overseas, acting as the North American voice to ensure features hit the mark on usability, performance, and reliability.

Customer Empathy & Cross-Functional Evangelism
You will champion the user. You are the internal conduit for customer empathy, responsible for embedding deep user understanding and insights across engineering, UX, marketing, and customer support.
You will collaborate with design and UX to prototype, test, and refine intuitive on-device interfaces for complex data like offline maps, routing, and telemetry.
You will partner with marketing and customer support to ensure seamless feature rollouts, clear customer education, and tight feedback loops from our most active community members.
Feature Definition & Lifecycle Execution
Write exceptionally clear PRDs, user stories, and feature specs that bridge the gap between high-level vision and technical execution.
Own the feature lifecycle from initial concept and user research through beta testing, launch, and post-launch iteration.
Balance software capabilities with hardware constraints, ensuring our wearable ecosystem delivers flawless performance in the elements.

Your First 90 Days
Days 1-30: Audit & Orient
Deep dive into our existing product line, mapping architecture, software ecosystem, and customer feedback channels.
Meet the cross-functional team: engineering, UX, marketing, and customer support.
Identify immediate friction points in navigation and mapping workflows and map out high-impact opportunities.

Days 31-60: Align & Ship Quick Wins
Establish your rhythm with overseas development teams, refining communication loops and spec handoffs.
Partner with UX and engineering to roll out immediate user-experience enhancements to existing navigation flows.
Establish a systematic process for feeding customer insights from support and marketing directly into the product backlog.

Days 61-90: Build & Scale
Present your 6-month feature roadmap to leadership.
Own the end-to-end definition and early development cycle for your first major zero-to-one outdoor feature.
Cement your role as the internal champion for customer empathy, driving cross-functional alignment across product, marketing, and support.

What We're Looking For
Required
7+ years of experience in product management , with a strong focus on consumer hardware, mobile apps, or wearable technology.
Deep domain expertise in mapping, geolocation, and outdoor navigation technologies (e.g., offline maps, GPX routing, altimetry, GPS optimization).
Demonstrated track record of customer empathy : you know how to talk to users, extract deep behavioral insights, and evangelize that perspective across an entire organization.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills: proven experience working effectively with remote engineering teams, UX designers, marketing, and support without relying on direct authority.
Data fluency: comfortable digging into usage analytics, crash logs, and customer feedback to make hard prioritization calls.
Exceptional written and verbal communication—you can write a tight, ambiguous-free PRD and present a clear executive narrative with equal ease.

Strongly Preferred
Authentic connection to our space : genuine passion for fitness, sport, or endurance athletics. Whether you are an ultra-marathoner, trail runner, triathlete, or off-road cyclist, you understand our customer because you are our customer.
Experience shipping products that blend hardware and software ecosystems.
Experience working within distributed, international, or matrixed organizational structures.
Self-directed operator who thrives in a growing team environment, defaults to action, and is comfortable shaping processes as we scale.

Why Join Us
High-impact ownership : you are joining a growing North American product team where your work directly shapes the core experience of our devices.
Remote-first culture : we trust high performers to manage their own time and output.
A product worth building : our hardware consistently wins performance and value comparisons against competitors at 2-3x the price.
A team that trains : we sponsor major race series, share Strava segments, and take outdoor sports seriously.

Benefits of Working At Zepp Health:
Competitive salary, Vacation day, sick day
Health insurance, Vision insurance, Dental insurance, life insurance
401K & Matching
Year-end Bonus pay
